messages.say:
Could you reoreganize the the structure of the repo?
Instead of organizing by assignment, lessons, and notebooks, organize by weeks. Each week would have a directory that contains the assignment, lessons, and notebook.

After reorganizing, update the README to reflect the change as well.

Let me start by exploring the current repo structure.

All done! Here's what changed:

**New structure** — each week is now self-contained:
```
week01/
  lessons/   (01_r_and_rstudio.md, 02_computer_programming.md, …)
  notebook/  (week01_setup.Rmd)
  assignment.md
week02/ … week07/  (same pattern)
week08/
  final_project.md
```

The old top-level `lessons/`, `notebooks/`, and `assignments/` directories have been removed, and all links in the README have been updated to match the new paths.

On the README
instead of having the notebook and assignment as separate columns. can you display notebook and assignment separately underneath the tables.

Also, can you include the a short blurb about the final project in the about this course section. The idea is to give students a teaser of what they will learning to accomplish by the end of the course (and have aware that there is a final project)

Done! Here's a summary of the two changes:

**Notebook & assignment formatting** — for every week, the lessons table is now single-column, with the notebook and assignment as labeled links directly below it. Much cleaner than having sparse empty cells across a wide table.

**Final project teaser** — added a paragraph to the "About this course" section that previews what students will be able to do by the end (wrangling, visualization, inference, regression, survival analysis) and explicitly mentions the final group project, so students know from day one that it's coming.
